case_information.customer_feedback_summary: The reviews repeatedly praise the property's central location, cleanliness and modern in-room amenities (coffee machine, microwave, fridge). Recurring negatives include the absence of an on-site reception and inability to store luggage after checkout, and mixed feedback about breakfast—often served offsite with opinions ranging from extensive/superb to poor value. Bed comfort and room views drew mixed comments; a few isolated remarks mentioned staff responsiveness, the exterior and a small child's bed.
